eva (People Ops): Quick thread — I'm drafting a manager checklist and evidence template for promotions + comp-band transitions. Need clarity on acceptable evidence for "stretch" work and on how to handle exceptions. Deadline to submit manager notes: Tue 11:59pm PT.

mike (Eng Manager): For stretch work, 3 bullets max per example: what they did, timeframe, concrete impact (numbers if possible). metrics > adjectives.

olivia (Manager): +1. Also include who else validated the work (peers, PM). helps when a role change isn't in the job desc.

liam (IC): If someone did leadership/UOPs outside their scope (mentoring, owning infra), can we use feedback excerpts? I don't want to paste whole Slack threads.

people-ops-eva (People Ops): Yes — short excerpts are fine. Prefer a one-line context + a 1-2 sentence quote + link to source. Example format below.

comp-bot: :rotating_light: Reminder: Promotion nominations close in 5 days (https://go.company/promo-form) :rotating_light:

mike (Eng Manager): Example evidence format that works for us:```- Scenario: Led migration of inference service to shard-based cache (Apr-Jun)
- Role: Project lead (owned roadmap, design reviews, rollout)
- Impact: 30% p95 latency reduction and $12k/mo infra savings
- Validation: Post-rollout perf dashboard link, peer review from @olivia
```

eva (People Ops): Thanks, Mike. Also note exceptions process: if an IC's role maps to a higher band but comp band constraints block promotion, we accept a path note and timeline from manager + a suggested counteroffer range. People Ops will flag to comp committee.

olivia (Manager): How strict are we on timeline? Someone started doing higher-level work 2 months ago but it's consistent since then.

eva (People Ops): We typically want ~3 months of sustained impact, but for high-impact projects we can accept 6-8 weeks with strong validation. Put the start/stop dates in the evidence and mark as "emerging" if <3 months.

liam (IC): For equity bumps tied to comp changes, what should managers include?

eva (People Ops): Include current equity grant date/size, suggested new target (market-aligned), and rationale (promotion vs retention). We'll route to People Ops comp for sizing.

mike (Eng Manager): One more: if manager and peer feedback conflict, what's the tie-breaker?

eva (People Ops): We escalate to calibration panel. Manager narrative + documented evidence (metrics, PRs, customer notes) carries the most weight; peer feedback helps resolve edge cases. If conflicting, add a short reconciliation paragraph in the submission.

olivia (Manager): Sharing the checklist draft here for quick review before I send to managers org-wide: https://go.company/promo-checklist-draft Please comment inline by Mon noon.

people-ops-eva (People Ops): Awesome — thanks. I'll collect comments, finalize templates, and post the final form + a short walkthrough recording. If you need a special exception (urgent retention), DM me and cc your director.

comp-bot: :white_check_mark: Promo form saved. Last edit by eva at 2026-03-10 09:12 PT.
